findings.reason: The first implementation returned allow when a partial observation happened to include every selected path. The contract now treats partial coverage as an explicit coverage_partial unknown even when all selected rows are present.

The first implementation counted every selected snapshot row as checked. checked_files now counts only selected paths that had a supplied observation; omitted rows remain explicit unknowns or refusals.

The first validator accepted query terms and selection counts beyond the existing selection producer limits. It now enforces the shipped query-term, selected-file and tree-file limits and checks UTF-8 text bytes plus SHA-256 before comparison.
